name: sunset_track
caption: the sunset seen by C0362200 (E18, Hamina, Finland; metadata says direction UNKNOWN): the sun's path for the evening drawn from the fitted pose (magenta) and the 5 blooms fitted with a circle (cyan); yaw 267.9, pitch -4.6, roll 0.9, HFOV 48

name: sunset_follow
caption: the same evening frame by frame: the magenta circle is where astronomy plus the fitted pose says the sun must be — it follows the real sun down to the horizon (8 frames, 10 min apart)

name: naive_picks
caption: what the look-alone detector (sun_pixel_position, built for synthetic discs) called the sun in the same camera: 22 picks, 3 exactly the sun, 2 on the sun but off-centre, 17 something else — station text, signs, white cars

name: jackknife
caption: refit with each sun frame removed: yaw barely moves, roll and the focal length are the weak directions of a 1-hour low-elevation arc — this is why the PoC reports them with their spread instead of a single number

name: bloom_bias
caption: for blooms cut by the station-name band the centroid sits 12.4 px (mean) away from the circle fitted to the unclipped rim; the fit uses the circle

name: numbers
caption: one camera out of 807 stations gave a sun track of 4 or more frames on 2026-09-20/21 (2 more had 3 frames and were left out); the vanishing point of its lanes, turned into a world bearing with the sun-derived pose, agrees with OpenStreetMap
